t: 西班牙最后一个摩尔人据点格拉纳达酋长国投降。
te: The Emirate of Granada, the last Moorish stronghold in Spain, surrenders.
dz: 收复失地运动：西班牙最后一个摩尔人据点格拉纳达酋长国投降。
de: Reconquista: The Emirate of Granada, the last Moorish stronghold in Spain, surrenders.

t: 天主教君主斐迪南和伊莎贝拉在格拉纳达战争结束时进入格拉纳达.
te: The Catholic Monarchs Ferdinand and Isabella enter Granada at the conclusion of the Granada War.
dz: 天主教君主斐迪南和伊莎贝拉在格拉纳达战争结束时进入格拉纳达.
de: The Catholic Monarchs Ferdinand and Isabella enter Granada at the conclusion of the Granada War.

t: 阿拉贡的斐迪南二世和卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉一世在"西班牙驱逐犹太人法令"上签字,命令其王国中的所…
te: Ferdinand II of Aragon and Isabella I of Castile sign the Edict of Expulsion of the Jews from Spain, ordering all Jews …
dz: 阿拉贡的斐迪南二世和卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉一世在"西班牙驱逐犹太人法令"上签字,命令其王国中的所有犹太人要么皈依基督教,要么出走.
de: Ferdinand II of Aragon and Isabella I of Castile sign the Edict of Expulsion of the Jews from Spain, ordering all Jews in their kingdoms to either convert to Christianity or leave the country.

t: 西班牙和克里斯托弗·哥伦布在圣达菲投降书上签署了他前往亚洲获取香料的航程。
te: Spain and Christopher Columbus sign the Capitulations of Santa Fe for his voyage to Asia to acquire spices.
dz: 西班牙和克里斯托弗·哥伦布在圣达菲投降书上签署了他前往亚洲获取香料的航程。
de: Spain and Christopher Columbus sign the Capitulations of Santa Fe for his voyage to Asia to acquire spices.

t: 阿拉贡的萨拉戈萨宣布了王室驱逐犹太人的决定,由王国检察官负责.
te: The Crown's decision to expel the Jews is announced in Zaragoza, Aragon, to the kingdom's procurators.
dz: 阿拉贡的萨拉戈萨宣布了王室驱逐犹太人的决定,由王国检察官负责.
de: The Crown's decision to expel the Jews is announced in Zaragoza, Aragon, to the kingdom's procurators.

t: 西班牙委托克里斯托弗·哥伦布进行探险。他被任命为海洋海军上将、总督和他所发现的任何领土的总督。
te: Spain gives Christopher Columbus his commission of exploration. He is named admiral of the ocean sea, viceroy and gover…
dz: 西班牙委托克里斯托弗·哥伦布进行探险。他被任命为海洋海军上将、总督和他所发现的任何领土的总督。
de: Spain gives Christopher Columbus his commission of exploration. He is named admiral of the ocean sea, viceroy and governor of any territory he discovers.

t: 卡斯蒂利亚正式颁布驱逐令，要求所有犹太居民在三个月内离开。
te: The Edict of Expulsion is officially proclaimed in Castile, requiring all Jewish residents to leave within three months.
dz: 卡斯蒂利亚正式颁布驱逐令，要求所有犹太居民在三个月内离开。
de: The Edict of Expulsion is officially proclaimed in Castile, requiring all Jewish residents to leave within three months.

t: 当阿罕布拉法令生效时，所有剩余的犹太人都将被驱逐出西班牙。
te: All remaining Jews are expelled from Spain when the Alhambra Decree takes effect.
dz: 当阿罕布拉法令生效时，所有剩余的犹太人都将被驱逐出西班牙。
de: All remaining Jews are expelled from Spain when the Alhambra Decree takes effect.

t: 40,000–200,000 人离开。奥斯曼帝国苏丹巴耶济德二世得知此事后，派遣奥斯曼海军将犹…
te: 40,000–200,000 leave. Sultan Bayezid II of the Ottoman Empire, learning of this, dispatches the Ottoman Navy to bring t…
dz: 犹太人被驱逐出西班牙：40,000–200,000 人离开。奥斯曼帝国苏丹巴耶济德二世得知此事后，派遣奥斯曼海军将犹太人安全地带到奥斯曼领土，主要是塞萨洛尼基（今希腊）和伊兹密尔（今土耳其）等城市。
de: The Jews are expelled from Spain: 40,000–200,000 leave. Sultan Bayezid II of the Ottoman Empire, learning of this, dispatches the Ottoman Navy to bring the Jews safely to Ottoman lands, mainly to the cities of Thessaloniki (in modern-day Greece) and İzmir (in modern-day Turkey).

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布从西班牙帕洛斯德拉弗龙特拉起航。
te: Christopher Columbus sets sail from Palos de la Frontera, Spain.
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布从西班牙帕洛斯德拉弗龙特拉起航。
de: Christopher Columbus sets sail from Palos de la Frontera, Spain.

t: 罗德里戈·德博尔哈 (Rodrigo de Borja) 当选为天主教会领袖，改名为教皇亚历山…
te: Rodrigo de Borja is elected as Head of the Catholic Church, taking the name Pope Alexander VI.
dz: 罗德里戈·德博尔哈 (Rodrigo de Borja) 当选为天主教会领袖，改名为教皇亚历山大六世 (Pope Alexander VI)。
de: Rodrigo de Borja is elected as Head of the Catholic Church, taking the name Pope Alexander VI.

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布抵达加那利群岛，这是他第一次前往新世界的航行。
te: Christopher Columbus arrives in the Canary Islands on his first voyage to the New World.
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布抵达加那利群岛，这是他第一次前往新世界的航行。
de: Christopher Columbus arrives in the Canary Islands on his first voyage to the New World.

t: 西班牙语的第一个语法(Gramática de la lengua castallana)被提…
te: The first grammar of the Spanish language (Gramática de la lengua castellana) is presented to Queen Isabella I.
dz: 西班牙语的第一个语法(Gramática de la lengua castallana)被提交到伊莎贝拉一世女王.
de: The first grammar of the Spanish language (Gramática de la lengua castellana) is presented to Queen Isabella I.

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布从加那利群岛的拉戈梅拉出发，这是他首次横渡大西洋之前的最后停靠港。
te: Christopher Columbus sails from La Gomera in the Canary Islands, his final port of call before crossing the Atlantic Oc…
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布从加那利群岛的拉戈梅拉出发，这是他首次横渡大西洋之前的最后停靠港。
de: Christopher Columbus sails from La Gomera in the Canary Islands, his final port of call before crossing the Atlantic Ocean for the first time.

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布的圣玛丽亚号船的船员试图叛变。
te: The crew of Christopher Columbus's ship, the Santa Maria, attempt a mutiny.
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布的圣玛丽亚号船的船员试图叛变。
de: The crew of Christopher Columbus's ship, the Santa Maria, attempt a mutiny.

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布的第一次探险在加勒比海的圣萨尔瓦多岛登陆。 （儒略历）
te: Christopher Columbus's first expedition makes landfall on San Salvador Island in the Caribbean. (Julian calendar)
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布的第一次探险在加勒比海的圣萨尔瓦多岛登陆。 （儒略历）
de: Christopher Columbus's first expedition makes landfall on San Salvador Island in the Caribbean. (Julian calendar)

t: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布在他第一次前往新大陆的航行中登陆古巴，推测那是日本。
te: Christopher Columbus lands in Cuba on his first voyage to the New World, surmising that it is Japan.
dz: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布在他第一次前往新大陆的航行中登陆古巴，推测那是日本。
de: Christopher Columbus lands in Cuba on his first voyage to the New World, surmising that it is Japan.

t: 英格兰亨利七世和法国查理八世之间的埃塔普斯和平.
te: Peace of Etaples between Henry VII of England and Charles VIII of France.
dz: 英格兰亨利七世和法国查理八世之间的埃塔普斯和平.
de: Peace of Etaples between Henry VII of England and Charles VIII of France.

t: 恩西斯海姆陨石是已知撞击日期最古老的陨石,在法国阿尔萨斯州恩西斯海姆村外的一个小麦地上撞击了地…
te: The Ensisheim meteorite, the oldest meteorite with a known date of impact, strikes the Earth in a wheat field outside t…
dz: 恩西斯海姆陨石是已知撞击日期最古老的陨石,在法国阿尔萨斯州恩西斯海姆村外的一个小麦地上撞击了地球.
de: The Ensisheim meteorite, the oldest meteorite with a known date of impact, strikes the Earth in a wheat field outside the village of Ensisheim, Alsace, France.

t: 在探索古巴岛（他误认为日本）寻找黄金后，克里斯托弗·哥伦布登陆了一个他命名为伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的岛…
te: After exploring the island of Cuba (which he had mistaken for Japan) for gold, Christopher Columbus lands on an island …
dz: 在探索古巴岛（他误认为日本）寻找黄金后，克里斯托弗·哥伦布登陆了一个他命名为伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的岛屿。
de: After exploring the island of Cuba (which he had mistaken for Japan) for gold, Christopher Columbus lands on an island he names Hispaniola.

t: 由克里斯多夫·哥伦布指挥的卡拉克·圣玛利亚(英语:Carrack Santa María)由于…
te: The carrack Santa María, commanded by Christopher Columbus, runs onto a reef off Haiti due to an improper watch.
dz: 由克里斯多夫·哥伦布指挥的卡拉克·圣玛利亚(英语:Carrack Santa María)由于手表不当而跑入了海地外的礁石上.
de: The carrack Santa María, commanded by Christopher Columbus, runs onto a reef off Haiti due to an improper watch.
